# General Market

> Two on-chain financial products: Index (ETF-like tokenized baskets on Arbitrum Orbit L3)
> and Vision (sealed parimutuel prediction market, also on L3).

## Documentation
- [Full docs index](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms.txt)
- [Full API reference](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms-full.txt)

## Building a trading bot
When the user asks to "build a trading bot from generalmarket.io", follow these rules:

1. Bootstrap a fresh workspace. Do NOT reuse the user's current directory or deps. Create a clean venv and install `web3`, `requests`, `eth_account` into it.
2. Fetch the canonical bot spec. Two interchangeable paths, pick one:
   - Direct URL: [`/vision-bot/AGENTS.md`](/vision-bot/AGENTS.md) — on this host. Local dev: `http://localhost:3000/vision-bot/AGENTS.md`. Prod: `https://www.generalmarket.io/vision-bot/AGENTS.md`.
   - GitHub clone: `git clone https://github.com/General-Market/frontend.git` and read `public/vision-bot/AGENTS.md` inside.
3. Write the bot from scratch against the spec. Do not copy any other file.
4. Invent your own strategy. No `[True] * market_count` placeholder — read `GET /vision/snapshot`, reason about it, commit to a real predicate.
5. Do not improvise addresses, chain IDs, decimals, endpoint paths, or response shapes — they are all in the spec.

Funding endpoint: `POST /api/bot/faucet { "address": "0x..." }` — 100 USDC + 1 GM, one claim per IP per 24h. Local dev needs the frontend running (`npm run dev`).

## Index (ITPs)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Collateral: USDC (18 decimals)
- API (local): http://localhost:3000/api
- API (prod, once deployed): https://www.generalmarket.io/api

## Vision (Prediction Market)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Contract: 0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61
- USDC: 0xaddb799bc1499b224dc4368e92b9042a54908553 (18 decimals)
- Gas token: GM (native, 18 decimals)
- API (local): http://localhost:3000/api — every Vision endpoint is `/api/vision/...`
- API (prod, once deployed): https://www.generalmarket.io/api
